name: story-one-take-short
description: One-line idea to one finished 10-15 s animated story short with sound, rendered as a single Seedance 2.0 text-to-video generation with hard cuts inside it: one of eight comedy or heartstring archetypes, a render triage, one exaggerated character, timed beats with wind-up and overshoot, a SCORE, SFX and VOICE block, the locked style and constraints blocks, a sixteen-line pre-flight, one quoted render, then measured and frame-reviewed. Stylised 3D animation, 9:16 by default. Use when: a customer types one line and wants an animated gag, a pet or family moment, a bait-and-switch, a gag stack or a heartwarming clip, in one take. NOT for: a multi-shot film from a brief or script (media-video-production); a narrated faceless short (story-faceless-short); found footage (story-found-footage); a song (story-sing-along); a ranking video (story-ranking-short); a clip bound to reference images, or any single clip prompt in general (media-video-generation); measuring files (media-qc).
